clauses.title: Scope – Requirements and
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements and methods of test for rigid conduit fittings manufactured from insulating materials for use with circular, rigid, non-flame propagating and non-threadable plain conduits of insulating materials. This standard covers conduit fittings suitable for temperature between -5ºC and + 60ºC. Only plain type fittings are covered in this standard. The fittings covered by this standard are-couplers, bends, elbows,tees, inspection sleeves, and boxes.

clauses.title: Requirements
clauses.text: 2. Requirements

clauses.title: Shall be homogenous and non
clauses.text: 2.1 Shall be homogenous and non-porous.

clauses.title: Inside and outside surfaces
clauses.text: 2.2 Inside and outside surfaces shall be smooth, clean and uniform and free from projections, grooving and other defects.

clauses.title: Elbows – Area of
clauses.text: 2.3 Elbows - Area of the opening in case of inspection elbow shall not be less than two and a half times the internal cross-sectional area of the corresponding conduits.

clauses.title: Tees – Area of
clauses.text: 2.4 Tees - Area of the opening for inspection tees shall not be less than three times the internal cross sectional area of the corresponding cover.

clauses.title: Cover of Circular Box
clauses.text: 2.5 Cover of Circular Box - Minimum thickness of 1.6 mm.

clauses.title: Dimensions
clauses.text: 3.   Dimensions  (in mm) - Nominal size of the outlets of the fittings shall correspond to the nominal outside diameter of the conduits covered by IS 9537 (Part 3) : 1983*. Note - For detailed dimenasions of slip type couplers, socketed type couplers, clamp type couplers, normal type bends, slip type coupling bends, normal type elbows, normal type tees, socketed type tees and spout type circular boxes refer to Tables 1 to 9 of the standard. * Conduitsfor electrical insulations, Part 3, Rigid plain  conduits of insulating materials.

clauses.title: Tests
clauses.text: 4. Tests

clauses.title: Type Tests
clauses.text: 4.1 Type Tests

clauses.title: Visual
clauses.text: 4.1.1  Visual  examination

clauses.title: Checking of dimensions
clauses.text: 4.1.2 Checking of dimensions

clauses.title: Resistance to heat –
clauses.text: 4.1.3 Resistance to heat - Diameter of the impression shall not exceed 2 mm when tested as prescribed.

clauses.title: Resistance to burning –
clauses.text: 4.1.4 Resistance to burning - When tested as prescribed, if the sample burns, it shall do so slowly that the burning shall not spread. Any flame shall die out in less than 30s after removal of the burner.

clauses.title: Moisture absorption test –
clauses.text: 4.1.5 Moisture absorption test - Shall not exeed 1.0 per cent.

clauses.title: Ressistance to chemical action
clauses.text: 4.1.6 Ressistance to chemical action - There shall be no visible sign of deterioration of the specimen whentested as prescribed. Slight changes in colour shall however be allowed.

clauses.title: Copper test – There
clauses.text: 4.1.7 Copper test - There shall be no visible evidence of copper salts or the sample.

clauses.title: Resistance to oil –
clauses.text: 4.1.8 Resistance to oil - Shall not show any sign of penetration of oil, cracking or splitting when tested as prescribed.

clauses.title: Resistance to impact –
clauses.text: 4.1.9 Resistance to impact - Shall show no damage or cracks visible to the naked eye.

clauses.title: Tests for electric characteristic.
clauses.text: 4.1.10 Tests for electric characteristic.

clauses.title: Acceptance tests – Tests
clauses.text: 4.2 Acceptance tests - Tests specified in 4.1.1, 4.1.2, 4.1.3 and 4.1.10.

clauses.title: Routine tests – Tests
clauses.text: 4.3 Routine tests - Tests specified in 4.1.1 and  4.1.2. Note - For methods of tests refer to the standard. For detailed information, refer to IS 3419 : 1989 Specification for fittings for rigid non-metallic conduits (second revision).
